stalls.summaryZh: 把滷味再用三杯醬汁快炒，香氣重口味鹹甜，是夜市排隊最久的攤之一，常要等半小時以上。
stalls.summaryEn: Braised snacks get a second toss in three-cup sauce; intensely fragrant and one of the longest queues in the market, often 30+ minutes.

sources.title: 食尚玩家：雲林斗六夜市攻略（觀光、成功、石榴班）

stalls.summaryZh: 外皮煎到像酥皮一樣脆，放涼也不軟；老闆穿迷彩服很好認。
stalls.summaryEn: The edges fry up crisp like pastry and stay crunchy even when cool; staff in camouflage outfits make it easy to find.

sources.title: 食尚玩家：雲林斗六夜市攻略（觀光、成功、石榴班）

stalls.summaryZh: 以久煮鳳梨為底的水果茶，果香濃，網友說一晚能賣上千杯。
stalls.summaryEn: Fruit tea built on long-simmered pineapple; strongly fruity, with reports of a thousand-plus cups sold a night.

sources.title: 食尚玩家：雲林斗六夜市攻略（觀光、成功、石榴班）

stalls.summaryZh: 現煮粉圓Q彈，鮮奶黑糖口味最受歡迎，甜度不膩。
stalls.summaryEn: Freshly cooked, springy tapioca; the brown-sugar fresh-milk version is the favourite and not cloying.

stalls.summaryEn: Crackly garlicky skin over juicy meat; portions are big enough to count as dinner.

stalls.summaryEn: Crisp-outside, molten-inside takoyaki; the wasabi flavour gets the most recommendations.
